objective: Three-lane parallel research: orientation curves, QM-ERROR advance, new transcript statistic.

tasks.title: Lane A: Identify curves with public End(E) for orientation experiments

handoff.objective: Resolve RT-CTRL-002/003: identify concrete supersingular curves with publicly known endomorphism rings where that knowledge does NOT come from solving the isogeny path-finding problem.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether there exist supersingular curves with known End(E) suitable for testing SSI-O2 endomorphism-assisted path-finding, without circular dependence on the target hardness assumption.
constraints: Identify concrete curves (j-invariants) at specific primes where End(E) is known.
Explain WHY End(E) is known without solving the path-finding problem (e.g., CM construction, special j-invariant, Deuring correspondence from known quaternion order).
State which orientation/endomorphism information is publicly derivable for each curve.
Assess density: how many such curves exist at a given prime? Is this a measure-zero special case?
If no suitable curves exist, state this clearly with justification — this closes the orientation lane.
Do NOT assume End(E) is known for random curves (that IS the hard problem).
Include dominated_by and sota_delta per inventor-protocol.
Candidate sources: j=0 (End known for all p≡2 mod 3), j=1728 (End known for all p≡3 mod 4), CM curves lifted to supersingular via reduction, Bruhat-Tits tree special vertices.
completion_gate: At least one concrete curve identified with known End(E) and justification, OR a clear argument that no suitable curves exist

constraints: Bounded zero-compute step only (ledger/obligation, not implementation).
Do NOT re-queue QM-STOPPING while REV-1 and REV-2 are unmet.
Do NOT iterate toy peak-byte width.
Do NOT attempt fake-τ gate B.
Retain FC0_QUERY_MEMORY_SEMANTICS_UNRECONCILED.
QM-STOPPING FAIL (lane paused) must remain acknowledged.
Pin-seeking without inventing CollimationSieve APIs is acceptable.
Include dominated_by and sota_delta.
completion_gate: QM-ERROR state advanced or concrete obstruction documented
No QM-STOPPING re-queue without REV satisfaction

tasks.title: Lane C: New transcript-leakage statistic motivated by EXP-SSI-S1 negative

handoff.objective: Propose a new transcript-leakage statistic or detection approach motivated by the EXP-SSI-S1 clean negative and informed by KLPT algebraic structure.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether there exists a theoretically motivated statistic that chi2_7/mod-7 cannot detect but which exploits known KLPT algebraic constraints.
constraints: Must explain WHY the new statistic could detect something chi2_7/mod-7 missed.
Must be theoretically motivated by KLPT algebraic structure (not just 'try another test').

Candidates: (a) higher-order correlations between successive transcripts, (b) joint distribution of (s mod q1, s mod q2) for coprime q1,q2, (c) lattice-reduction signature in the quaternion norm constraint, (d) conditional distribution given public commitment curve.
If no theoretically motivated new statistic exists, state this clearly — the lane is paused rather than continued on speculation.
Must include falsification criteria, controls/null, and budget estimate.
Include dominated_by and sota_delta.
Do NOT propose scaling up chi2_7/mod-7 — that is closed by DEC-20260804-cfe4d0.
completion_gate: At least one theoretically motivated statistic proposed with algebraic justification, OR clear argument that the lane should be paused
